user_quotes: That display cover fit very well on the display and tubes and wiring and everything there in the faucet tip.

The only thing that looks like a problem, and I think this problem existed before, but in that last photo you'll see I point out there's a gap hole that you can see through in the corner there, the way that display cover is shaped and the way that our display tip is shaped.
I think it'd be neat if that hole could not be something visible to the user.
geometry: Lowered display with four 1 mm foot recesses and two 1 mm switch pockets; Sculpted cover with matching Industrial reach and arch offset.

observations.photos_show: Assembled Sculpted cover, display and all three tubes; triangular opening at the front corner exposes internal hardware in photo 8.
observations.remaining_issue: Visible front-corner opening between the sloping cover edge and tip ledge.

scope: Reported complete faucet-head fit applies to the identified print. Installation force, retention force, endurance and hydraulic function are not measured by these photographs. The corner-overlap proposal is unprinted.
image_processing: EXIF orientation applied; resized to at most 1600 px; metadata omitted.
